title: The resonance graphs of coronoid systems and nanotubes
summary: The resonance graph of a hexagonal system is connected, which shows that a perfect matching can be transformed into any other perfect matchings by a series of flips along hexagons. However, the resonance graph of a coronoid system (with holes) is not necessarily connected. Saldanha et al. (Discrete Comput. Geom. 14 (1995) 207-233) used homology and cohomology theory to obtain three versions of criteria for two tilings of a quadriculated region in the plane to be in the same connected component of the flip graph.
